pages.text: The world before it cooled: black stone, seas of fire, ash falling from a red sky. Nothing lives. Its $(l)air burns$(): without warded goggles I am poisoned while I stay.

pages.title: Already Standing
pages.text: And yet the obelisks are there, black and crisp, in a world still molten. The Nails are older than the world's crust. Whoever drove them did it before there was a world to stand on.
